title: Bodyguard Kogoro Mouri
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri, Ran) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. case_type: attempted_murder -- nobody actually dies in this episode; Dobashi's plan (kill Reina, kill Mouri, then stage Ryo's own death as a guilt suicide) is foiled by Kogoro before it is completed, so 'victim' roles here mark intended targets, not fatalities. Old cases/ep794 file's culprit (s6=Dobashi) matches the transcript -- no identity error -- but it was structurally thin: it used generic 'knows' edges for every suspect->victim link instead of real motives/relationships, put all six suspects 'was_at' a single 'Street' location including Dobashi (the transcript never places Dobashi at the departure street scene -- he first appears later at Auberge Muto, introduced as Kogoro's bodyguard-exam instructor), omitted Dobashi's daughter, the Muto innkeepers, and Kushizaki's visiting/rejecting-judge backstory entirely, and completely missed the episode's central twist clue: Kushizaki, not Ryo, was the actual substitute judge who rejected Dobashi's daughter at the fateful audition (Ryo was out sick that day) -- meaning Dobashi's revenge target was factually mistaken. A gunshot-like sound is heard during the island confrontation but no weapon is ever shown on screen, so no weapon object node was invented for it (kept as an edge-level note instead).

clues.desc: Every rowboat was swept off-course by the fog-driven wind and waves, but Dobashi's motorboat reached the island first, unaffected -- matches only someone who had studied the lake's drift patterns in advance.
Kushizaki, not Ryo, was secretly the substitute judge who rejected Dobashi's daughter's audition -- Dobashi's revenge target was factually mistaken.
